periodicConflict.policy: Actual app normal2-second native autosaving; no test delay, scripted edit, manualSave or deactivation before conflict surface. One native paste transaction stages an unsavedX; assert disk still original at external-write boundary.
periodicConflict.external: Uncoordinated atomic UTF8BOM/LF/combining/emoji external replacement against localUTF16LEBOM/CRLF unsavedsource.
periodicConflict.checks: Require native conflict surface under periodic saves, local source and external bytes retained before choice; click nativeRevert; require external source/bytes and sheet dismissal; subsequent edit/Save must retain external encoding/BOM baseline.
periodicConflict.limit: Fixture staging itself must be accepted at standard timing; failure before conflict is not accepted as production bug. SaveAnyway/SaveAs and recoverable-version choices remain required.

versions.policy: Native user paste and explicitSave create their own history. Never inject an NSFileVersion, copy an old version over current source or programmatically replace/revert contents.
versions.checks: Exact UTF16LEBOM/CRLF original and savednewerbytes; original appears in native saved history; File/BrowseAllVersions enabled; capture tree/image; click nativeRestore and native confirmation ifpresent; browser dismisses; source/diskexactoriginal; newerbytesremain recoverable in history.
versions.limits: Runtime may reveal Versions UI/window/viewing-mode gaps. Read-only old-version interaction, multiple selected history entries and comprehensive keyboard/accessibility remain required.

isolation: UUID-owned authored fixture folder only. Clipboard types/data copied/restored around each single paste, never logged. Test app terminates before per-file NSFileVersion.removeOtherVersionsOfItem and folder cleanup. No user docs or unrelated version history touched.
